rationale: The plan correctly identifies the data state (raw featureCounts integers) and loads them via DESeqDataSetFromMatrix with an explicit ~condition design, control as reference, median-of-ratios inside the model, no tximport and no length offset, and states the low power of 3 vs 3 as a caveat. QC covers library sizes, VST PCA and sample distances coloured by condition with a stated no-drop policy; the low-count filter is filterByExpr-style and justified with the retained count reported; BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage for reported effects is explicit, though the |log2FC|>1 count is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold. Enrichment was not asked but is added correctly (full Wald-ranked list, MSigDB 2026.1 human hallmark/GO BP, size window 15-500, tested-gene universe for ORA). Reporting names methods, thresholds, tested/significant counts and design caveats, but does not commit to reporting package versions.
